Mobilisation Advance –
This shall be limited to 10% of the Contract value and shall be paid in 2 stages :
Stage 1– 5% of Contract Value on signing of the contract agreement.
advance.notes: Paid in two stages of 5% each. The advance is interest-bearing; misused amounts attract 15% interest per annum. Recovered pro-rata from running bills once work reaches 15% of contract value until 85%.

liquidated_damages.value_text: Liquidated damages for delay range from 0.01% to 0.30% per week depending on the extension tier, up to a maximum cap of 5% of the contract value.
liquidated_damages.quote: Provided also, that the total amount of liquidated damages under this condition shall not exceed 5% of the contract value or of the total value of the item or groups of items of work for which a separate distinct completion period is specified in the contract.
liquidated_damages.notes: Clause 17B outlines multiple tiers: (i) 0.01% to 0.05% per week for up to 25% extension, (ii) 0.10% per week for 25% to 50% extension, and (iii) 0.30% per week for above 50% extension. The cap is 5%.
liquidated_damages.reasoning: Clause 17B on page 60 specifies tiered liquidated damages for contractor delay ranging from 0.01% to 0.30% of the contract value for each week or part of the week depending on the duration of the extension, subject to an overall maximum cap of 5% of the contract value. The primary rate specified for the highest tier is 0.30% per week, and the cap is explicitly stated as 5%.
